items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So he and I was buddies, see.

ctx.x: I played a little bit with him, and then we got a little thing going there. Charlie Costain(?), his mother was a Creole, a real Creole woman that talked French and did everything like a Frenchwoman. She ran around with French people. And Charlie Costain(?) was a little like what someone would maybe call him a Mama's boy -- they thought he was a Mama's boy. Charlie Costain was hip to it; you know, how(?) the gang would see him. So he and I was buddies, see.
